note: Sandy: every candidate for a polished-demo input, measured with the real pipeline and Stage Ready's own measurer. 2026-09-20 (morning): two contiguous excerpts of the untouched recording, trimmed only, to test whether a stable section passes the head-height gates after the reframe fix — neither did. 2026-09-20 (afternoon, reviewer's controlled-demo rule): the search for a CLEAN BASE — a Sandy source that passes verification on its own, to be deliberately degraded with one repairable framing defect — over all three real Sandy recordings. None passes. Sandy's polished-demo input stays the untouched recording (fix holds → verify fails → reshoot).
why: His crown leaves the picture on 81–86 % of frames in every stable section, so the head-top anchor the solve holds is a completed crown, rebuilt from reference frames; its switches move the anchor more than the performer does. Under the 21-s run's own solve, even the steadiest 10 s reads a 2.28 % canvas spread against the 2 % gate. Trimming cannot change that, and stabilising, synthesising or re-anchoring is not allowed.
kept: the untouched sandy_hackett_v2.mp4 in both the polished demo (as the fix → caught → reshoot recording) and the evaluation corpus

clean_base_search_2026_09_20.rule: find the cleanest legitimate Sandy source/intermediate that passes verification on its own; verify it first; only then inject one repairable defect. Allowed: alternate take, trim, remux, fps. Not allowed: synthesised pixels, crown reconstruction, stabilisation, appearance changes, threshold changes.

sandy_hackett_v1.mov.result: pipeline refuses at stage 3: Apple Vision body pose on 6 % of frames (BodyTrack survey over the whole take, work/midtown_sandy_hackett_v1_full/pose.csv) — under the 60 % gate; the crown is at the top edge on most frames as well. Not processable.

sandy_hackett_v2.mp4.result: the demo's untouched recording: pose 100 %, crown cut on 76 % of frames → completed crown → head_spread 2.9 % / drift 5.3 px → reshoot; excerpts 2.3 % / 2.4 % (candidates above). Its intermediates (band_ext, fg, comp) carry the pipeline's completed crown, so they are not a permitted base.

sandy_hackett_0910.mov.recorded: 2026-09-10, standing chest-up at a kitchen counter, black turtleneck, arms mostly out of frame; walks in 0–3.5 s; both arms raised out of frame at 27.2–28.3 s
sandy_hackett_0910.mov.survey: BodyTrack over the whole take (work/midtown_sandy_hackett_0910_full/pose.csv): pose on 58 % of frames — Apple Vision loses the chest-up framing whenever his arms are out of the picture (identical-looking frames alternate found/not found in ~1 s bursts). Best windows: 15-s 70 % (15.5–30.5 s, includes the arm raise); 20–30-s 64 %. Crown inside the picture on every frame (DNN scout, every 15th frame: mask top 62–133 px of 1080 in the settled stretches).

clean_base_search_2026_09_20.why: Three real recordings, three different honest failures. v1: Apple Vision does not find a seated close-up (6 %). v2: the crown is cut, and a completed crown jitters. 0910: the crown is inside and the matte is clean, but (a) the chest-up framing with the arms out of frame leaves the pose on 58 % of frames — only two 10-s windows reach 74 %; (b) it is a close-up (shoulders 76–78 % of the canvas at the head target; the size cap pushes the head to 0.51–0.54) and over-lit (×0.36 wanted, held at ×0.80); and (c) with a real crown and a good matte, his head still moves 5.6 % of the source height while he talks — 2.3–2.4 % of the canvas after the solve, against the 2 % gate. That last one is his performance, not a framing defect: trimming, remuxing and frame-rate changes cannot touch it, and stabilising him is not allowed. No Sandy base passes verification on its own, so there is nothing to degrade.
clean_base_search_2026_09_20.kept: the untouched sandy_hackett_v2.mp4 stays the polished demo's Sandy (fix → caught → reshoot) and is the evaluation corpus's natural failure case; the 0910 and v1 takes and the three 0910 windows join the corpus as measured (archive files listed above; not in the repo, not on S3).
